[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Senks''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] agent of [[Darth Baras]], posing as a leader of the [[Corellian resistance (Galactic War)|Corellian resistance]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]], part of the larger [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Corellia]], Senks posed as a leader of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] resistance while doing spy work for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]], whose secrets he safeguarded. He maintained a base of operations in a stronghold in the [[Labor Valley]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] that allowed him to escape through a labyrinth of secret passages. [[Darth Vowrawn]] planned to take him out and delivered pulse disruptors to the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] in order to lock Senks' secret passages so that he could be cornered. Upon being [[Mission to Corellia (Emperor's Wrath)|confronted]] by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], Senks admitted to being Baras' spy. Assuming the Wrath to be one of the rogue Sith he was to keep in check, Senks pleaded to be spared, explaining that he sent resistance forces into battles and that, without him, they could not win and the Empire would lose the upper hand. However, the Wrath refused to listen to his pleas for mercy and killed Senks before destroying his database.<ref name="TOR" />
